### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Leber congenital amaurosis 8  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2343)

**Proposed mechanism:** CRB1 (HGNC:2343) —DISRUPTS→ Retinal integrity and cell adhesion (GO:0031573); Retinal integrity and cell adhesion (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Retinal dystrophy (HP:0000547); Retinal integrity and cell adhesion (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Cone-rod dystrophy (HP:0000549); Retinal integrity and cell adhesion (GO:0031573) —LEADS_TO→ Leber congenital amaurosis (HP:0000557). Loss-of-function mutations in CRB1 disrupt retinal integrity and cell adhesion pathways, leading to a spectrum of retinal dystrophies including cone-rod dystrophy and Leber congenital amaurosis.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in CRB1 with a gain-of-function mechanism or variants in distinct pathways that independently lead to these phenotypes. _(variant: rs74315597)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CRB1 in retinal development and maintenance could lead to targeted therapies for both conditions. Investigating the specific downstream effects of CRB1 dysfunction on photoreceptor and RPE cells is crucial for developing therapeutic strategies.
